name: braintrust
summary: Successfully completed the Braintrust evaluation quickstart. The eval ran via the SDK and reported scores (77.78% Levenshtein score). Steps completed: 1) Installed braintrust and autoevals packages, 2) Created tutorial_eval.py with the exact code from the quickstart, 3) Ran the eval with `braintrust eval --no-send-logs tutorial_eval.py`. The output showed the eval processed 2 data items and 2 tasks, then printed the summary score of 77.78% Levenshtein.
deviations: 1. The Braintrust website (www.braintrust.dev) was not accessible from the sandbox due to TLS connection reset errors, so I fetched the quickstart instructions from the GitHub README (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/braintrustdata/braintrust-sdk-python/main/README.md) instead. 2. The Braintrust API endpoint was also unreachable from the sandbox, so I had to add the `--no-send-logs` flag to run the eval locally without uploading results to Braintrust. The quickstart docs say to run `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY=<YOUR_API_KEY> braintrust eval tutorial_eval.py`, but the API key was already exported in the environment and the connection to Braintrust servers failed regardless.
